row_count_basis: Printed horizontal text rows, including heading, figure caption and footer. Tall fractions remain one row each; 因为 shares its horizontal row with the inequality. Figure labels do not count as prose rows.

typography_and_glyphs.heading_number_and_sentence_stops: Filled baseline dot, not a hollow Chinese ideographic full stop. Visual transcription uses ASCII period; raster pixels alone do not establish the historical Unicode encoding.
typography_and_glyphs.commas_colon_parentheses_quotes: Comma with descending tail; final colon after 公式; paired parentheses around 图 223 and both prose asides; paired double quotation marks around 光学钟; equation-number dot between 8 and 2.
typography_and_glyphs.because_row_layout: 因为 at left and the inequality centered on the same row, with no comma following 因为.
typography_and_glyphs.outgoing_row: No terminal punctuation after 位置.
typography_and_glyphs.spacing: Whitespace around inline Latin variables and numbers is typesetting, not extra source words.

relationships: O lies left of O_1 on a shared horizontal X/X_1 baseline.
Each origin joins its own up-pointing Y axis and down-left-pointing Z axis.
The Y axes are parallel; the Z axes are parallel.
X and X_1 are collinear and right-pointing, with distinct visible arrowheads: X inside the long line and X_1 at its far-right end.
A separate rightward velocity arrow begins on the upper Y_1 axis; its label is an italic v with a small vector arrow above it.
A shaded horizontal rectangular rod sits right of O_1, with its lower edge on the shared X/X_1 baseline.
A labels the rod's left upper endpoint; B labels the right upper endpoint.
The rectangular rod retains its border and patterned interior.
figure_inventory.crop_requirement: Retain every axis endpoint, arrowhead, origin, frame label, rod endpoint label, patterned rod and velocity accent. Exclude heading, prose, figure caption and page footer; incidental scan specks are not invented topology.

source_only_crop.alteration: Native-size rectangular crop only; no resizing, masking, relabeling or drawing.
